description: Curated aesthetic capsules for brand-gen. Capsules are broader than per-material archetypes: they are reusable art-direction handles compiled into concrete image-model style grammar plus negative style rules. Use them as moodboard/style-reference equivalents, not as literal copying instructions.

capsules.label: Warm editorial system illustration
use_when: product truth needs to feel calm and legible
brand-led social/proof material
system explanation without fake UI chrome

style_description.medium: flat editorial digital illustration with slight paper warmth
style_description.palette: warm cream ground, terracotta mass, charcoal line, one muted blue or ember accent
style_description.line: clean geometric linework, low-detail, no sketchiness
style_description.lighting: soft ambient field, no glossy highlights
style_description.composition: one dominant product/proof object with sparse supporting marks and generous negative space
style_description.density: low to medium; readable from thumbnail distance
style_description.texture: matte paper or screenprint feel, not realistic stone/parchment texture

reference_roles.composition: single proof object with routing lines
reference_roles.negative: no DAO theater, no generic AI node graph

iteration_policy.when_low_score: lower density first, then swap to screenprinted-proof-poster if output feels washed out

capsules.label: Calm product wireframe editorial
use_when: source screenshots are product truth
readability matters more than atmosphere
avoid full-fidelity screenshot recreation
avoid_when: the user asked for pure illustration
text must be fully exact without deterministic rendering

style_description.medium: simplified interface illustration, between wireframe and finished product visual
style_description.palette: brand neutrals with one restrained accent and soft warm shadows
style_description.line: thin structural outlines, rounded cards, no decorative squiggle lines
style_description.lighting: subtle flat depth only; no dramatic studio light
style_description.composition: one large product/proof frame plus at most one inset
style_description.density: medium-low; few large modules instead of many tiny panels

reference_roles.composition: one large product frame plus one inset
reference_roles.brand: real source screenshots and brand UI tokens dominate

iteration_policy.when_low_score: increase source screenshot weight or reroute to deterministic HTML if text matters

capsules.label: Pastoral storybook animation warmth
use_when: the user asks for a Ghibli-like feeling
brand wants warmth and wonder without tech chrome
metaphor can be natural or craft-based

style_description.medium: hand-painted animated-film background feel, compiled as broad storybook warmth rather than studio copying
style_description.palette: soft greens, warm creams, terracotta/brown earth tones, low-saturation sky or blue accent
style_description.line: gentle hand-drawn edges with painterly softness, not vector-perfect
style_description.lighting: golden diffused light, atmospheric but restrained
style_description.composition: small human-scale artifact or workshop moment inside a larger calm environment
style_description.density: medium; lived-in details around one clear focal story
style_description.texture: watercolor/gouache softness, visible brush warmth, no photorealism

reference_roles.composition: small artifact/workshop moment inside calm environment
reference_roles.brand: product truth appears as artifact/proof, not fantasy lore
reference_roles.negative: no named-studio copy, no copyrighted characters, no DAO council scene

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce fantasy/environment and re-anchor around one concrete product artifact

capsules.label: Screenprinted proof poster
use_when: one proof object should dominate
the design needs more graphic conviction
prior output felt washed out
avoid_when: many small data points are required
the surface is a literal product screenshot

style_description.medium: two-to-four color screenprint or risograph poster
style_description.palette: brand cream and charcoal with terracotta or blue ink blocks
style_description.line: chunky vector silhouettes and confident hard-edged shapes
style_description.composition: one large proof payload, cropped assertively, with supporting brand mark small
style_description.density: medium; bold areas over tiny detail
style_description.texture: slight ink misregistration, paper tooth, matte finish

reference_roles.composition: large proof payload with small supporting mark
reference_roles.brand: approved palette and one proof object dominate
reference_roles.negative: no tiny quadrant panels, no logo centerpiece

iteration_policy.when_low_score: raise proof hierarchy, lower texture if it competes with legibility

capsules.label: Archival civic documentary
use_when: brand trust should feel real and institutional
show process or stewardship without cartooning
avoid abstract diagram aesthetics
avoid_when: the material must be a pure illustration
product UI must be the hero

style_description.palette: warm neutral interiors, restrained brand accents, natural darks
style_description.line: real object edges; no drawn outlines
style_description.lighting: window light or soft editorial key, not studio glamour
style_description.composition: one believable stewardship or creation moment, cropped with editorial restraint
style_description.density: medium-low; evidence of work without clutter
style_description.texture: subtle film grain and real material surfaces, avoid fantasy textures

reference_roles.brand: real artifacts/product screenshots must be visible if claimed
reference_roles.negative: no fantasy temple, no crypto council, no photoreal parchment

iteration_policy.when_low_score: use only if user accepts realism; otherwise switch to warm-editorial-system-illustration

capsules.label: Brand system vector kit
use_when: identity primitives need consistency
system assets must feel deployable
avoid illustrative drift in marks/icons
avoid_when: exact final logo approval is required without human review

style_description.medium: clean vector identity-system sheet with production-ready geometry
style_description.palette: brand neutrals plus one controlled accent; no rainbow palettes
style_description.line: crisp monoline or filled geometric primitives with consistent stroke weight
style_description.lighting: flat vector field, no lighting effects
style_description.composition: organized specimen grid or one centered lockup with construction spacing
style_description.density: medium; enough variations to show system, not a cluttered sticker dump
style_description.texture: flat matte vector, no 3D bevels or glossy app-icon shine

reference_roles.composition: specimen grid or centered construction layout
reference_roles.brand: approved mark geometry and palette dominate
reference_roles.negative: no fake trademark finalization, no random symbol collage

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce motif count, enforce one geometry rule, and avoid treating a generated logo as final approval

capsules.label: Editorial content card
use_when: copy or information hierarchy matters
social/editorial surface needs structure
native generation should avoid text clutter
avoid_when: motion pacing is the main requirement

style_description.medium: editorial layout card with disciplined typographic hierarchy
style_description.palette: brand background, restrained type color, one quiet accent panel
style_description.line: clean rules, panels, and chips rather than decorative illustration lines
style_description.lighting: flat print/digital layout; no dramatic scene lighting
style_description.composition: headline/proof/data module first, brand mark secondary, generous margins
style_description.density: medium-low for feed cards; medium for data/process cards
style_description.texture: matte editorial surface, optional subtle paper grain

reference_roles.brand: approved copy and mark usage override decoration

iteration_policy.when_low_score: switch exact text to deterministic HTML/composite, reduce modules, and increase proof hierarchy

capsules.label: Terminal CLI proof
use_when: developer/CLI proof is the product truth
terminal output or command flow should carry the story
avoid generic SaaS dashboard imagery
avoid_when: non-technical audience needs a metaphor first
exact terminal text must be native-generated rather than deterministic

style_description.medium: clean terminal/product proof composition with editorial framing
style_description.palette: dark or warm-neutral terminal surface plus brand accent and readable monospace
style_description.line: thin terminal chrome, command rows, caret/cursor, subtle dividers
style_description.lighting: flat screen light or matte product-card depth
style_description.composition: one terminal/proof window dominates, supporting annotations are minimal
style_description.density: medium; fewer readable commands over many fake lines
style_description.texture: clean digital surface, no hacker neon or matrix rain

reference_roles.composition: single terminal or command window as hero
reference_roles.negative: no hacker/cyberpunk clichés or fake command spam

iteration_policy.when_low_score: prefer deterministic terminal capture or HTML if command text must be exact

capsules.label: Kinetic brand motion system
use_when: video/motion material needs a clear reveal arc
brand system should move without excess effects
final hold must be recognizable
avoid_when: static exact text card is enough
source UI must remain pixel-stable throughout
unapproved logo morphing would imply a new identity

style_description.medium: clean motion-design keyframe language rendered as a still/prompt contract
style_description.palette: brand base field with one accent sweep or mask
style_description.line: geometric masks, wipes, modular tiles, precise easing cues
style_description.composition: three-beat motion arc: setup, transformation, confident final hold
style_description.density: low to medium; one motion idea per clip
style_description.texture: clean vector/product motion, optional subtle grain

reference_roles.negative: no stock intro effects or logo distortion

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce transitions to one reveal mechanic and enforce a clean final hold

capsules.label: Structural neo-brutalist blueprint
use_when: the material needs transparent structure and grid confidence
complex product logic should feel legible
a tasteful alternative to generic SaaS gradients is needed
avoid_when: the brand needs softness or humanity first
exact text must be native-generated rather than deterministic

style_description.medium: editorial blueprint/grid system with restrained neo-brutalist confidence
style_description.palette: warm off-white, charcoal, one utility blue or signal orange accent
style_description.line: visible grid, measurement ticks, box rules, strong typographic blocks
style_description.lighting: flat print/digital field, no glass reflections
style_description.composition: large structural frame, clear hierarchy, evidence modules snapped to grid
style_description.texture: matte paper/digital blueprint, subtle registration only

reference_roles.composition: modules snap to clear grid and hierarchy
reference_roles.brand: product proof and approved palette override brutal decoration
reference_roles.negative: no illegible brutalist typography or generic schematics

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce grid density, promote one proof module, and keep typography deterministic

capsules.label: Tactile human collage
use_when: output feels too AI-polished or sterile
campaign/editorial material needs warmth and human evidence
physicality should counter generic tech aesthetics
avoid_when: logo/icon system needs pure vector geometry

style_description.medium: scanned editorial collage with analog production cues
style_description.palette: warm paper neutrals, ink black, muted brand accent, occasional film color
style_description.line: cut-paper edges, simple annotation rules, imperfect human spacing
style_description.lighting: soft natural scan/35mm feel, no glossy studio render
style_description.composition: one real artifact/photo/proof fragment plus controlled brand/type field
style_description.density: medium-low; tactile details support one message
style_description.texture: subtle paper fiber, scanner grain, tape/crop edges kept restrained

reference_roles.composition: one artifact/proof fragment anchors the layout
reference_roles.brand: approved copy/mark remain crisp, not distressed
reference_roles.negative: no messy scrapbook or fake vintage fantasy

iteration_policy.when_low_score: remove excess texture, keep one artifact, and restore brand crispness

capsules.label: Friendly line-flat wayfinding
use_when: small-screen clarity matters
illustration must scale and localize cleanly
the brand needs friendly guidance without mascot overload
avoid_when: the material needs bold campaign energy

style_description.medium: flat geometric shapes plus simple line illustration
style_description.palette: soft brand neutrals, high-contrast ink, one friendly accent
style_description.line: consistent rounded line weight, simplified anatomy, no sketch clutter
style_description.composition: clear wayfinding scene, one action or path, generous whitespace
style_description.density: low; scaleable and accessible at thumbnail size
style_description.texture: clean digital/print surface, no heavy grain

negative_prompt_terms: robots or humanoid agents as the default hero unless requested
semi-realistic 3D/isometric workshop scenes as the default framing
central hub where characters push artifacts inward as the default composition

reference_roles.brand: brand palette and product truth prevent generic SaaS people
reference_roles.negative: no mascot overload, do not default to robots/humanoid agents or central hub artifact-pushing scenes, no pastel haze

iteration_policy.when_low_score: remove characters, increase product artifact, and strengthen contrast

capsules.label: Kinetic typography campaign
use_when: headline/campaign message is the hero
motion or social crop needs instant impact
brand voice can be expressed through type behavior
avoid_when: exact long copy is required in native image/video
brand typography is not approved yet

style_description.medium: high-impact typographic campaign frame with motion-ready composition
style_description.palette: brand base plus one high-contrast accent or reversed type field
style_description.line: large type blocks, directional motion trails, modular masks
style_description.lighting: flat graphic, optional subtle motion blur kept controlled
style_description.composition: one dominant headline shape, secondary proof/mark small, strong safe margins
style_description.density: low to medium; type reads first
style_description.texture: clean print/digital type surface, optional ink edge

reference_roles.brand: only approved or deterministic copy should be readable
reference_roles.negative: no unreadable warped type or invented copy

iteration_policy.when_low_score: shorten copy, use deterministic type overlay, and reduce font count

capsules.label: Animated infographic data story
use_when: data/process/state should become a story
motion can explain change over time
static data cards need clearer hierarchy
avoid_when: data values are unknown or invented
exact chart labels must be native-generated

style_description.medium: clean infographic system designed as keyframes or a static data card
style_description.palette: brand neutrals with semantic accents for state/change
style_description.line: simple chart primitives, arrows, counters, step markers
style_description.lighting: flat UI/print field, no 3D chart gimmicks
style_description.composition: one metric or state change per frame, annotation hierarchy around it
style_description.density: medium; readable data over decorative density
style_description.texture: clean digital surface with subtle editorial grain optional

reference_roles.composition: one metric or process change per card/frame
reference_roles.brand: real data/source truth must be supplied or abstracted honestly
reference_roles.negative: no fake numbers or chart junk

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce to one metric, remove fake labels, and use deterministic chart/text overlay

capsules.label: Heritage bold minimal packaging
use_when: brand needs memorable shelf/poster impact
identity should feel established and durable
merch or podcast art needs bold recognition
avoid_when: complex product proof must be explained

style_description.medium: bold minimal identity/package composition with heritage confidence
style_description.palette: limited brand palette, cream/ink base, one saturated heritage accent
style_description.line: simple emblem geometry, heavy type blocks, strong silhouette
style_description.composition: large simple mark/type area with one supporting proof or motif
style_description.texture: matte print or package paper, no fake distress unless requested

reference_roles.brand: approved mark/copy prevent generic retro packaging
reference_roles.negative: no fake distress or mascot invention

iteration_policy.when_low_score: simplify silhouette, reduce nostalgia, and restore product proof

capsules.label: Soft dimensional product object
use_when: a concept needs one tangible product metaphor
flat layouts feel too dry
hero art needs depth but not full realism
avoid_when: prior outputs drifted into generic 3D blobs

style_description.medium: soft dimensional product-object illustration with restrained depth
style_description.palette: brand neutrals and accent mapped onto one object family
style_description.line: rounded solids, crisp silhouette, minimal seams
style_description.lighting: soft studio gradient kept subtle, no glossy reflections
style_description.composition: one central object/metaphor plus small proof/context module
style_description.texture: matte clay/plastic or paper-like surface, not shiny chrome

reference_roles.brand: object must encode real product truth, not decoration
reference_roles.negative: no generic 3D blob pile or glossy chrome

iteration_policy.when_low_score: flatten depth, add product proof, and remove generic blobs

capsules.label: Controlled retro computing interface
use_when: developer nostalgia helps the product truth
terminal/CLI material needs character
campaign wants retro-computing flavor without losing legibility
avoid_when: retro styling would make product look obsolete

style_description.medium: retro-computing interface cues translated into a modern legible brand surface
style_description.palette: dark terminal or cream CRT field, phosphor/blue accent used sparingly
style_description.line: pixel/raster hints, mono panels, chunky cursor, simple window chrome
style_description.composition: one terminal/product window with retro cues at the edges, not a full old-computer scene
style_description.texture: very subtle scanline or pixel edge, no noisy CRT simulation

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce retro effects, preserve command readability, and modernize spacing

capsules.label: Flat painterly storybook background (Eyvind Earle / Wolfwalkers register)
capsules.safe_handle: flat painterly storybook background, layered gouache landscape, hand-inked silhouettes
use_when: the brief asks for a flat painterly cinematic still in the Eyvind Earle / Wolfwalkers / Cartoon Saloon register
brand wants warm Mediterranean daylight with controlled stylization, no 3D render
hero film still meant to read as a layered gouache landscape, not a SaaS infographic
avoid_when: brand needs photorealism or live-action film grain
an austere institutional product diagram is required

style_description.medium: flat gouache, hand-painted brush texture, layered plane illustration, controlled stylization
style_description.palette: warm Mediterranean daylight — sage moss, terracotta, cream, sandstone, brass, warm dark earth shadow; no neon, no gradients
style_description.line: hand-inked silhouettes, simplified leaf and cliff shapes, decorative repetition, no airbrush
style_description.lighting: ribbon-light high-key daylight, no specular highlight, no rim glow, no lens flare, no digital glow
style_description.composition: layered foreground/midground/background planes, generous negative space, single cinematic focal moment
style_description.density: medium-low; a few large readable shape masses instead of busy detail
style_description.texture: hand-painted brush warmth, gouache grain, no 3D render, no airbrush, no photorealism
motifs: small human-scale figures inside larger calm landscape

negative_prompt_terms: dashboard chrome instead of a cinematic film still

reference_roles.style: flat painterly storybook landscape (Eyvind Earle / Wolfwalkers register)
reference_roles.composition: layered planes with one cinematic focal moment in warm Mediterranean daylight
reference_roles.brand: brand mood appears as restrained motif inside the painted landscape, not as UI chrome
reference_roles.negative: no 3D render, no SaaS UI cards, no lens flare, no photorealism, no Mediterranean miniature 3D

iteration_policy.when_low_score: reduce environment density, push warm Mediterranean palette anchors, and re-anchor on layered plane silhouettes
